BuiltWith.description:
The build that wrote the manifest (the determinism settings: nothing here is
configurable at run time).

avian_features.description: The avian3d features the physics was built with.

CapturePlan.description:
A capture plan file, schema v1. Lengths are metres, speeds m/s, forces N,
masses kg; there is no unit key.

capture_sphere.description: The capture sphere. Absent: every default applies.

device.description: The capture device. Absent: every device default applies.

migrated_from_v0.description: What a migrated v0 file held that v1 has no field for (written back unchanged).

name.description: Display name shown to the user. Not used as a lookup key. Must not be blank.

phases.description: The phases in order; a capture starts in the first. At least one.

schema_version.description: File format version; `1`. A file without it is a v0 plan and is migrated on load.

tether.description: Id the tether is registered under. Must not be blank.

CapturePlanDevice.description: The capture device. Every field is optional; an absent field takes its default.

end_mass_kg.description: Mass of the root and of the tail in kg. Default 2.0; greater than 0.

joint_damping_angular.description: Angular damping of each tether joint. Default 1.0; not negative.

joint_damping_linear.description: Linear damping of each tether joint. Default 1.0; not negative.

segment_mass_kg.description: Mass of each interior tether node in kg. Default 0.1; greater than 0.

segment_spacing_m.description:
Distance between tether joints in metres. Default 0.1; greater than 0, and the
tether may have at most 1,000 bodies (a warning above 200).

tether_length_m.description: Physical length of the tether in metres. Default 20.0; greater than 0.

CaptureSphere.description: The capture sphere around the target.

initial_radius_m.description: Radius in metres at the start of every capture. Default 25.0; greater than 0.

ConditionBounds.description: Bounds on one quantity; at least one, neither negative. Both strict.

greater_than.description: Holds while the quantity is above this value.

less_than.description: Holds while the quantity is below this value.

JsonOrbital.description:
One Space-Track GP (OMM JSON) record: the keys the sim reads. Other keys of a
record are ignored on read and not written back. `project.json` carries it as the
snapshot a body starts from.

inertia_kg_m2.description: Inertia tensor in kg m², row-major. Refused until v0.4.0-rc.4.

label.description: Display name. Must not be blank.

mass_kg.description:
Mass in kg; greater than 0. The target's is applied from v0.4.0-rc.1; the
chaser's is refused until v0.4.0-rc.4.

source.description: Where the orbit came from. Provenance only: the orbit is the source of truth.

ManifestElements.description:
Osculating Keplerian elements, metres and radians (degrees would not round-trip
bit for bit), valid at `epoch_utc`.

epoch_utc.description: The epoch the six elements are valid at, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ` (UTC).

raan_rad.description: Right ascension of the ascending node in radians.

semi_major_axis_m.description: Semi-major axis in metres; greater than 0.

ManifestOrbit.description: How a body's initial state is given: exactly one key.

oneOf.description:
The Space-Track GP (OMM JSON) record verbatim. The body starts from SGP4, as
an unedited catalog pick does.
Osculating Keplerian elements in metres and radians.

Chaser only: an offset from the target along V-bar or R-bar. Refused until
v0.4.0-rc.4.

ManifestSource.description: Where a body's orbit was taken from.

dataset.description: Path of the dataset file, relative to the project folder.

norad_id.description: NORAD catalog id of the record.

MigratedFromV0.description:
The v0 content a migration could not map, so the file can be written back
without losing it.

unmapped.description: Every unmapped v0 value with its JSON Pointer into the v0 document.

Phase.description: One phase of the plan: the controller's limits while in it and its transitions.

end.description: Marks an end phase (`success` or `abort`); an end phase has no transitions.

id.description: Phase id, unique in the plan and not blank.

max_force_n.description: Force applied to each tether node in N; not negative.

max_velocity_mps.description: Speed limit of the tether nodes in m/s; not negative.

shrink_rate_mps.description: Rate at which the capture sphere shrinks in m/s; not negative. Absent: no shrink.

transitions.description: Checked in order every step; the first whose conditions all hold fires.

PhaseEnd.description: How an end phase ends the capture.

ProjectManifest.description:
The project manifest, schema v1. Lengths are metres, angles radians, masses kg,
epochs UTC strings with microseconds.

active_plan.description:
Id (file stem) of the capture plan to run. Absent: the project's only plan,
else `example_plan`.

built_with.description: The build that wrote the file; read only by `ssg-sim validate`.

name.description: Display name of the project. Must not be blank.

recording.description: When and how this project records. Absent: manual recording only.

start_epoch_utc.description:
The simulation start epoch, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ` (UTC, microseconds).
The simulation always starts from exactly this string.

RecordingBlock.description:
The `recording` block of `project.json`: every key is optional and falls back
to the default named here. Durations are simulation seconds.

auto_start_phase.description:
Start a recording when the capture enters this phase (a phase id of the
active plan). Absent: no automatic start.

auto_stop_on_end.description:
Stop the recording `stop_after_end_s` after the capture enters an end phase.
Default `true`.

keyframe_interval_steps.description: Steps between two frames (K); at least 1. Default 32.

max_duration_s.description: The longest recording; greater than 0. Default 1800.

max_size_mb.description: The largest keyframe table in megabytes; greater than 0. Default 100.

max_tether_bodies.description: The most tether bodies a recording may hold; at least 1. Default 200.

stop_after_end_s.description: Seconds recorded after the end event; greater than 0. Default 60.

index.description: Position in `bodies` (0, 1, 2, …): the `body` column of the keyframe table.

name.description: Display name. Must not be blank.

oneOf.description: The tether's root, which the chaser carries.
The capture reached an end phase with outcome success and the stop delay passed.
The capture reached an end phase with outcome abort and the stop delay passed.
The simulation screen was left (or the headless run ended).

RecordingLimits.description:
The caps on a recorded segment: a recording is a short interaction, not a whole
approach (the recording budget is sized for 200 tether bodies).

max_duration_s.description: The longest segment in simulation seconds; greater than 0.

max_size_mb.description:
The largest keyframe table in megabytes (116 bytes per body per frame);
greater than 0.

max_tether_bodies.description: The most tether bodies (every body except the target); at least 1.

oneOf.description:
The application (its spawn-update step count varies, so a missing
`SessionStart` entry cannot be assumed).
The user (or the CLI's capture command).

RelativePreset.description: The approach line of a chaser placed relative to the target.

RelativeToTarget.description: A chaser placed relative to the target.

offset_m.description: Distance from the target in metres.

all_of.description: The conditions; all must hold (AND). At least one.

to.description: Id of the phase to enter.

distance_m.description: Range between the tether root and the target in metres.

relative_speed_mps.description: Magnitude of the LVLH relative velocity in m/s.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the v0 document, e.g. `/states/2/transitions/0/distance/units`.

value.description: The value as the v0 file had it.

description:
The recording manifest, schema v1. Lengths are metres, durations seconds, epochs
UTC strings with microseconds.

bodies.description:
The recorded bodies. `index` is the position in this list and the `body`
column of the keyframe table.

built_with.description:
The build that recorded; a recording replays bit for bit only on the same
build and platform.

end_step.description: The step of the last frame; at least `start_step`.

keyframe_interval_steps.description: Steps between two keyframes (K); at least 1.

limits.description: The caps on the recorded segment.

plan.description: A copy of that plan (schema v1) as it was when the recording started.

plan_id.description: Id (file stem) of the capture plan the recording ran. Must not be blank.

project.description:
The scenario at the start (`project.json` as the run used it). Absent: the
recording plays but cannot be verified by re-simulation.

start_phase.description:
The capture phase that started the recording; present exactly when
`start_trigger` is `phase`.

start_step.description: The simulation step the recording starts at.

title: RecordingManifest
